messages:
maria_support: @kevin_billing heads up — Orchid Labs (UK) reports two invoices for the same subscription renewal. They got charged by card and we also generated an invoice for their PO. Customer is asking for an immediate reversal and explanation. Invoice IDs: INV-2024-ORC-1001 (card) and INV-2024-ORC-1002 (PO). Both are for £14,400.00 incl. VAT.
kevin_billing: Ack. Do we have payment IDs / gateway traces? Need to confirm which payment actually settled. Also confirm VAT handling — UK VAT rate should be 20% on our end.
liam_eng: I pulled gateway logs — I see two webhook deliveries within 2s of each other for the same subscription: `payment.succeeded` x2. Looks like our webhook handler processed both because the second webhook arrived before idempotency dedupe kicked in. Snippet: 
```
{ "event": "payment.succeeded", "payment_id": "pay_9xZkL", "invoice": "INV-2024-ORC-1001" }
{ "event": "payment.succeeded", "payment_id": "pay_9xZkM", "invoice": "INV-2024-ORC-1002" }
```
liam_eng: The handler should dedupe on (customer_id, invoice_id, payment_reference). In this case, gateway sent slightly different payment_reference values (race), so our check missed it. Repro steps attached.
ops_lead: Customer wants the card refund processed ASAP and the PO invoice reversed/credit-noted. Can billing confirm steps and ETA? Customer quoted: "we were charged twice and it's blocking our accounting close".
sre-bot: Incident created: #INC-2024-4325 — duplicate-payment-due-to-webhook-race. Priority: high.
kevin_billing: Plan: 1) Refund the card payment `pay_9xZkM` immediately. 2) Issue a credit note against INV-2024-ORC-1002 (PO) and mark as reversed in our system. 3) Confirm net effect and send customer a reconciliation email with CR-9876 credit note and refund transaction ID.
kevin_billing: Running internal refund command now (audit-safe): 
```
/billing refund --payment-id pay_9xZkM --amount 14400.00 --currency GBP --reason "duplicate_charge" --notify-customer true
```
kevin_billing: Refund command returned: `refund_7a1b` — payment gateway shows refund initiated, settled in 1-3 business days. I've created credit note CR-9876 for INV-2024-ORC-1002 and set invoice status to "credited" in the ledger.
maria_support: Can you also confirm VAT on the credit note so Orchid gets a matching tax document? Their AP team insists on VAT lines.
kevin_billing: Yes — credit note CR-9876 includes VAT breakdown: net £12,000.00 + VAT £2,400.00 = £14,400.00. I've attached the PDF to the account.
liam_eng: For recurrence: pushing a small patch to webhook consumer to dedupe on gateway payment fingerprint + payment_id. Patch preview: 
```
if seen_payment(fingerprint) or seen_payment(payment_id): skip_processing()
else: process_and_mark(fingerprint, payment_id)
```
liam_eng: Will promote to prod after a quick canary. Should stop this class of duplicates.
ops_lead: Customer reply drafted: please confirm and send once refund and credit note are visible. Also offer a 1-month service credit for the inconvenience? Approve? :thinking_face:
kevin_billing: Approve 1-month credit. I'll add promo credit 1-month and note in the account. Promo credit id: PC-2024-55.
maria_support: Sent reconciliation message to customer with refund id `refund_7a1b`, credit note CR-9876 PDF, and confirmation of one-month service credit. They replied: "Thanks — refund visible in portal, we'll wait for bank settlement. Appreciate the quick turnaround." :white_check_mark:
liam_eng: Deployed webhook dedupe patch to prod (canary 5%). Monitoring logs for duplicate events.
sre-bot: Monitoring alert: duplicate_webhook_rate decreased from 0.12% -> 0.01% after canary deploy.
maria_support: Closing this thread once refund settles and customer confirms bank receipt. Leaving follow-up to liam/kevin for the dedupe rollout and audit entry.
kevin_billing: I'll add accounting entries and notify finance to reverse any recognition that happened on the PO invoice. Tagging for audit: FIN-AP: please expect a reversal next cycle.
maria_support: Thanks all. Marking as resolved in support queue — will reopen if customer reports anything else. :raised_hands:
